events.title: We are LIVE
events.summary: Good news, folks,Our Dune-inspired autobattler Steam Page is now live! For those of you who don't know, Terraformer Wars is an autobattler with a unique take on veteran units. In the future, mega-corporations send Terraformer colossal machines to fight over dominance on faraway planets. This is the final reveal from our 4 games developed during the same-time marathon.
